events.summary: The demo just got an update. Most of this comes straight from your feedback over the past week — thank you.Text size — new slider in Settings, default 130%, up to 150%. Scales text only, the board stays put. 2K / 4K — the game now fills high-resolution screens instead of sitting small in the middle; F11 toggles fullscreen. Live score preview — while placing cards, the panel shows this hand's estimated total (chips × mult = score). Rearrange and watch it move. Can be turned off in Settings. Mute

events.title: Demo is live — play Wuxing on Steam
events.summary: The Wuxing demo just went live on Steam. Place poker hands onto a 3×3 Five-Elements board, wake the guardian beasts on their home cells, and chain Generation to build the multiplier — or gamble on Counter for a bigger payout, though it calls down a storm that breaks over the next stage. The demo covers Spring and Summer — two full seasons, the Azure Dragon and the Vermilion Bird as bosses, over half the relic and talisman pool, roughly 30 to 45 minutes for a full run. Free, Windows, and playable
